learning_outcomes.text: Distinguish Operating System (OS) types, functions and characteristics
Describe aspects of process managment and related algorithms
Describe mechanisms related with inter-process communication and syncronization
Describe memory management models in multiprogramming systems and compare related algorithms. Explain virtual memory management methods
Explain the most common file system implementation issues
Identify OS security mechanisms and describe types of security attacks, and protection methods
Use the command line to work on a remote linux server; program shell script; use processing text and administration related commands
Program at the system level, using the OS functionalities and considering both sequential and concorrent programming

assessment_rules: This course uses only periodical evaluation, not allowing a single final exam. The overall evaluation requires: Trab+TPC >= 9.5 and PE >= 9.5. For the written exam, Test 1 and Test 2 each require a minimum grade of 8/20, and their average result must be >= 9.5/20.
